description: Lists the custom domains on this account with their status: verified (it can be bound with dname on deploy_app/deploy_compose, dns_entries on create_instance, or set_cluster_domain) or pending (its TXT check has not passed: get_domain_verification gives the record, verify_domain checks it). The public names that use a domain are in list_dns_entries. release_domain removes a domain from the account.
name: list_domains
title: List custom domains
